ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; high-intensity pixels (white) represent approximately 5% of the surface area, localized primarily at the tips, while low-intensity pixels (black) dominate >90% of the fluke.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black field with high-contrast contiguous white clusters at the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse white pixel speckling is mapped across the medial section of the right lobe and the lower-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with an approximate 42-degree divergence; base depth is approximately 12% of total lobe vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude irregular peaks and one deep, distinct valley. Right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of lower-amplitude jagged serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer lobe margins follow a convex trajectory tapering to acute tips; the trailing edge maintains an overall concave curvature toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups at the extreme tips of both lobes. Isolated circular high-intensity markers located on the lower-left lobe ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint vertical and diagonal linear high-contrast streaks visible on the right lobe; one distinct horizontal-diagonal scratch on the left lobe medial area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation (secondary notch) on the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy high-contrast encrustation on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical morphology of the trailing edge with significantly more tissue irregularity on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.
